scenarios.name: Policy and source conformity
scenarios.planned_witness: Approved M18-P01 through P20, exact graph prerequisites, source inventory and no unauthorized changes

assertions.expected: Every behavior-affecting M18-P01 through P20 choice is explicitly resolved and signed before affected code exists
M18-01..04 mapping, API/SQL/roles and test inventory match approved contracts on the frozen source
G16/G17 constraints, default-off gates and historical evidence remain unchanged

scenarios.name: Five-role permission enforcement
scenarios.planned_witness: Real authenticated HTTP, five-role positive/negative matrix and typed permission unit tests

assertions.expected: Support and Administrator within selected active organization can use exactly approved technical incident operations
Manager remains limited, Analyst denied, and Auditor is read-only only with explicit revocable M18 grant
Every permission is checked server-side; UI hiding and generic M16 audit grants cannot grant incident rights

scenarios.name: Tenant object isolation
scenarios.planned_witness: Two synthetic organizations; guessed incident, note, action, evidence IDs and raw SQL boundary

assertions.expected: List and detail return only selected-organization rows and allowed fields
Foreign incident/child IDs and protected cursors reveal no existence or data compared with unknown IDs
Composite tenant constraints prevent cross-organization notes, actions, evidence and assignment references

scenarios.name: Session, organization and revocation
scenarios.planned_witness: Live account/session/membership/organization suspension plus transaction-race probes

assertions.expected: Revoked, expired or disabled sessions reject protected operations immediately
Organization switch and membership/role revocation invalidate cached incident and cursor visibility
Revalidation inside write transaction prevents queued requests committing after revocation

scenarios.name: Creation, severity and input bounds
scenarios.planned_witness: Creation and validation tests, malicious and over-limit payloads

assertions.expected: A permitted create persists valid incident with New state, correct service, SEV-1..4 and UTC timestamps
Invalid severity, source, lengths, unknown fields and timestamps fail with zero side effects
Limited Manager creation omits forbidden technical fields and never conveys privileged detail access

scenarios.name: Seven-state positive transition chain
scenarios.planned_witness: State-machine unit, HTTP and committed event sequence

assertions.expected: New -> Triage -> Investigating -> Mitigated -> Monitoring -> Resolved -> Closed follows approved guards
Each accepted transition records exact previous/new state, actor, server UTC and incremented version
Current projection matches ordered immutable history and correct resolved/closed timestamps

scenarios.name: Illegal transition and bypass resistance
scenarios.planned_witness: Invalid jump, generic patch, forged actor and state-guard mutants

assertions.expected: Unapproved skips, terminal edits, duplicate closure and missing reason produce failure without state change
A generic mutation cannot overwrite state, actor, version, resolved or closed fields
Removing the transition guard is detected by an effective negative test

scenarios.name: Concurrent writers and stale version
scenarios.planned_witness: Real competing connections, row locks, expectedVersion regression

assertions.expected: Two concurrent updates from the same version commit at most one authorized state change
Losing request receives deterministic conflict without phantom event, note or audit
Role or assignee revocation racing the commit cannot publish unauthorized changes

scenarios.name: Idempotency and ambiguous retry
scenarios.planned_witness: Same operation key, changed payload, lost response and retry after restart

assertions.expected: Exact matching replay creates no duplicate incident event/action/audit and returns the recorded outcome
Same key with different payload is rejected without modifying incident or history
Unknown commit outcome is resolved through durable operation identity rather than claiming false success

scenarios.name: Append-only incident history
scenarios.planned_witness: Direct SQL UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE, EF mutation and migration tests

assertions.expected: Authorized app can append events/notes/evidence but cannot edit existing entries
API/worker runtime roles cannot UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE or disable guards on immutable tables
Historical timeline survives closure, reopen, API restart and migration upgrade unchanged

scenarios.name: M16 atomic audit coupling
scenarios.planned_witness: Injected audit insertion failure and direct transaction observation

assertions.expected: Every successful sensitive incident mutation commits exactly one allowlisted M16 audit with incident effect
Required audit write failure rolls back projection and append-only incident records
Audit metadata excludes note body, raw diagnostic values and credentials while preserving safe provenance

scenarios.name: Denied audit and database privilege
scenarios.planned_witness: Access denial with audit failure, runtime-role and migrator grants

assertions.expected: An unauthorized request never changes incident state even when denial-audit persistence fails
Only migrator holds schema authority and API/worker cannot update/delete protected audit and history
No pre-existing accepted M16 audit API permission or privacy/retention invariant changes

scenarios.name: Assignment and severity reassessment
scenarios.planned_witness: Active same-tenant assignee, reassignment, severity change and stale membership

assertions.expected: Only authorized actors assign to active permitted same-organization technical responders
Reassignment or SEV change records reason, prior/new value, actor and version
Foreign, removed or unauthorized assignee and unauthorized severity changes produce no effects

scenarios.name: Investigation notes and confidentiality
scenarios.planned_witness: Bounded notes, XSS canaries, response/logger audit export inspection

assertions.expected: Permitted notes preserve authorship, UTC and immutable chronology under correct visibility
Secret, HTML, oversized, malformed and private-data canaries cannot leak via audit/log/metrics/HTTP/browser
Manager/Analyst/foreign users cannot infer protected note contents or private diagnostics

scenarios.name: M17-safe evidence capture
scenarios.planned_witness: Sanitized source snapshot and negative raw trace or URL attempts

assertions.expected: An allowed service/rule/observed UTC snapshot with correlation digest is attached only by explicit authorized command
Raw trace payloads, unsafe URLs, tenant/user identifiers, secrets and unbounded labels are rejected or omitted
Stored safe evidence remains meaningful after M17 telemetry expires and missing values remain unknown

scenarios.name: Corrective actions and root cause
scenarios.planned_witness: Versioned action state, independent cause record, owner and cancel failure

assertions.expected: Investigation records cause classification or explicit approved unknown and associated actions
Action state/owner/evidence changes append versioned immutable history without silent overwrites
Cross-tenant action links, direct deletion and invalid action transition fail cleanly

scenarios.name: Evidence-required resolution and closure
scenarios.planned_witness: Contradictory recovery evidence, missing integrity proof and exception denial

assertions.expected: Monitoring -> Resolved requires recorded health, recovery and data-integrity checks under approved policy
Resolved -> Closed requires closure confirmation and all mandatory corrective-action dispositions
Missing, stale or contradictory evidence and unauthorized exception prevent closure and leave current state unchanged

scenarios.name: Reopen and repeated lifecycle
scenarios.planned_witness: Reopen after Resolved/Closed, concurrent reopen and state recovery

assertions.expected: Explicit authorized reopen enters approved investigation state with reason and new version
Prior closure, actor and verification evidence remain visible and immutable
Duplicate reopen or stale-version replay cannot fabricate a second lifecycle event

scenarios.name: Alert to manually confirmed incident
scenarios.planned_witness: Controlled M17 fault, safe alert preview and authenticated create

assertions.expected: M17 alert alone creates no incident before explicit user confirmation
Human-confirmed incident stores only safe observation snapshot and correct service/severity context
Wrong-organization or forged M17 reference cannot create/link incident or grant telemetry access

scenarios.name: Default-off telemetry and degradation
scenarios.planned_witness: Default Compose, collector down, stale/no telemetry and transport hold

assertions.expected: Incident CRUD remains available when M17 export is disabled/unreachable if required database and audit are healthy
Missing collector, expired series or absent signal displays unknown, never verified recovery
M9 transport hold, M10/M11/M15 opt-ins and M17 private default-off profile remain unchanged

scenarios.name: End-to-end fault, repair and integrity
scenarios.planned_witness: Real disposable readiness fault, logs/metrics and safe SQL checks

assertions.expected: Controlled fault produces bounded observable signal and an explicitly opened incident with reproducible symptoms
Mitigation and service restoration show actual health and relevant data-integrity proof
Closed/reopened evidence connects to the same incident/correlation digest without customer-data leak

scenarios.name: HTTP API safety and pagination
scenarios.planned_witness: Request schema, CSRF/Origin, cursor tamper, rate limit and errors

assertions.expected: All versioned routes follow defined request/response enums, bounded payloads and stable scoped pagination
Unauthorized, forged origin, invalid cursor and oversize requests fail with sanitized consistent status/code
503 or unknown commit outcome never becomes success, and retry-after-recovery preserves committed state

scenarios.name: Three-browser English/Turkish functional UI
scenarios.planned_witness: Chromium/Firefox/WebKit full auth workflows, locale, conflict recovery and org switch

assertions.expected: Support/Admin can create, transition, investigate, close and reopen in English and Turkish across three engines
Manager limited, Auditor granted read-only and Analyst denied views match backend; switching organizations clears stale data
Loading/empty/error/unknown/conflict and saved draft flows work without English-only text or hidden privilege changes

scenarios.name: Q3 snapshot and accepted regressions
scenarios.planned_witness: Disposable historic safe-copy or reasoned N/A, impacted regression outputs and original hashes

assertions.expected: Q3 representative historical snapshot boots, upgrades and integrity spot checks on disposable copy, OR exact NOT APPLICABLE evidence is recorded
Original retained volume is unchanged, and fresh/seeded migrations and runtime DB grants are correct
Impacted G16/G17 plus accepted business/notification/session regressions pass on exact candidate; no required skip

scenarios.name: Independent S25 review and G18 decision
scenarios.planned_witness: Raw source and manifest, exception ledger, independent review document and formal decision

assertions.expected: A distinct reviewer authenticates frozen source, hashes, 25 scenarios, 72 technical assertions and negative/security evidence
All policy, provenance, performance, Q3 and procedural exceptions are disclosed and dispositioned without editing failures
Independent signed PASS/NOT PASS recommendation is recorded; G18 remains NOT ACCEPTED until a separately explicit gate decision
